description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Own the customer-facing mobile and web applications from design through production, focusing on an intuitive experience for non-technical users. Combine solid full-stack engineering with strong database judgment and a good eye for product and design, iterating quickly and learning directly from users.
 What you'll do
 - Build and maintain mobile and web applications end to end, from interface to data layer.
 - Design simple, trustworthy user experiences that reduce confusion for non-technical users.
 - Shape data models and monitor application performance, including latency and API usage, as the user base grows.
 - Iterate quickly through experiments and A/B tests, shipping improvements to production continuously.
 - Spend time with real users to understand their behavior and turn what you learn into product improvements.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Strong full-stack engineering skills with particular depth in databases and data modeling.
 - A genuine eye for design, product and user experience, while remaining an engineer rather than a product manager.
 - A track record of shipping applications to production frequently, including personal side projects.
 - Close attention to detail and curiosity about how users behave.
 - Solid frontend ability to make an application look and feel right for a non-technical audience.
 - High agency and autonomy, comfort in a flat team of individual contributors, and a willingness to listen and learn.
 - Pride in engineering craft and a thoughtful approach to using AI tools without relying on them for judgment.
 - 0 to 5 years of experience, with evidence of impressive accomplishments such as founding and shipping a product, if no university degree.
 - Willingness to travel to meet users in person.
 Bonus points
 - Design or mobile development background.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 130,000 to 180,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Medical, dental and vision coverage
 - Life insurance
 - Health FSA
 - Retirement plan
 Location and work model
 - San Francisco, CA, United States
 - On-site
 - Full-time
